info.title: Reflective Graph Developer API
info.description: Versioned native developer API. Hosted access requires a verified Firebase email/password identity; local owner-token and demo-emulator modes remain available on loopback only. Production admission applies persistent request and execution allowances, not a monetary cap. Delegates semantics to the pinned Rust CLI.

get.description: Firebase identity modes only. Requires project owner; no membership list is exposed to editors or viewers.

default.description: 401 identity rejected; 403 not owner; 404 inaccessible or unsupported in local-token mode

post.description: Firebase identity modes only. Owner grants or changes viewer/editor membership; null removes membership. The owner cannot be changed. Maximum 32 members.

default.description: Structured error; invalid membership, missing access or capacity reached

LocalBearer.description: Only accepted when configured for local-single-owner mode.

FirebaseBearer.description: Signed Firebase ID token from reflective-graph-f1cd4; accepted only in firebase-production mode. Requires verified email and password sign-in provider. Revoked, disabled, expired and invalid credentials fail closed. Admission limits return 429; verified-email policy failures return 403.

EmulatorBearer.description: Firebase emulator ID token; only accepted in explicit firebase-emulator mode. Development tokens are unsigned and are not production credentials.

Settings.description: Pilot ceilings: 1000 steps/candidates, 1000000 work, 30000 ms. Only an operator-enabled authenticated local large-local-v1 route accepts the larger maxima below; clients cannot raise the service envelope.

execution_profile.description: Versioned matching/comparison work contract; recorded in traces and preserved on resume.

role.description: Requester's project role in Firebase identity modes

parent_version_id.description: Absent in older stores; absence and null mean no parent.

dataset_id.description: Present only for a version compiled from this immutable dataset; source digest must match.

application.description: Present for a calendar import; records schema, full row count, policy and immutable CSV digest.

submitted_by.description: Emulator UID; idempotency is scoped to this submitter and project

parent_job_id.description: Absent in older stores; absence and null mean no parent.

outcome.description: Engine outcome of verified trace, not synonymous with platform completion.
